Hi Alex — great to hear. Happy to run a 45m session.

Quick note: the week of Mar 8–14 has US DST change on Sun Mar 8 (US springs forward), while UK/EU don't change until later in March. That creates a one-week offset for a few days and can make calendar time math tricky for London participants.

Options that often work:
- Schedule a single slot at 14:00 ET (which is 19:00 in London during the mismatch week) — slightly late for UK, but accommodates US daytime and APAC may need to skip.
- Split into two shorter sessions (US-friendly morning and a separate EMEA/APAC-friendly slot).
- Pick a time that locks in for the majority and record the session for those who can't attend.

Marissa (CC'd) covers demos — Marissa, can you propose 2x 30–45m slots that work on Tue/Wed next week? Also looping Soojin for EMEA scheduling guidance.

Jordan Blake
